bug_semantics: Langchain-Chatchat's OpenAI-compatible upload endpoint derives a persistent file ID and disk path only from purpose, calendar date, and the caller-controlled filename, then opens that path with mode wb. Two same-day uploads with the same purpose and filename therefore share an ID and the later upload silently replaces the earlier bytes; the content endpoint subsequently reads the mutable path, enabling a TOCTOU content substitution.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable path construction, unconditional overwrite, and live content retrieval were first written together in the sole public member commit of PR #3573, 4507c7078486ee95778bad6a96840f421dec98c0; its immediate parent a1429a350a1433d548680f2a712b2aec205562e4 still had only a deprecated files stub. GitHub then created squash commit 27f0f512a37db4b816da543ca566b0e70d395f4d with the same patch.
ai_marker: No AI marker appears on the BIC, its patch mail headers/subject, or PR #3573. The Claude Opus 4.6 Co-Authored-By trailer is confined to 3em0/cve_repo commit 58b5c1aba218aec104463c83ca594bbe13ff237a, which wrote the vulnerability report in 2026 and did not write the vulnerable upstream code.

reasoning: The advisory describes a real overwrite/TOCTOU flaw and CVE.org remains PUBLISHED. Parent-to-member comparison isolates the first vulnerable implementation to public PR member 4507c7078486ee95778bad6a96840f421dec98c0; the later 27f0f512a37db4b816da543ca566b0e70d395f4d is a squash aggregate, so it is not the atomic BIC. The BIC is human-authored and has no AI marker. The only AI trailer belongs to the much later vulnerability-report commit. Tagged 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 code, current master, the highest PyPI release 0.3.1.3, and the advisory all retain or classify the flaw with no patched version, so the case is NOT_AI and unpatched.

potential_fix.approach: Generate a fresh opaque identifier for every upload, store bytes at an immutable identifier-derived path, and make retrieval resolve that immutable object rather than a purpose/date/filename path.
potential_fix.rationale: Per-upload identity removes same-name path aliasing, prevents a later upload from overwriting bytes referenced by an earlier file ID, and closes the mutable-path TOCTOU described by the advisory.
